list.title: Important Information
list.content: "Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it"

list.title: Will this moisturizer leave my skin sticky?
list.content: This is lightweight formula. Though it will provide your skin with deep moisturization, it will absorb quickly

list.title: Can I use this twice a day?
list.content: Yes, you can use as needed. Post application in morning, follow up with a sunscreen

list.title: How much time will it take to see results?
list.content: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months.

list.title: What is so special about this product?
list.content: It has Ceramides & Peptides which are found naturally in the skin barrier. It helps specifically to repair damaged barrier

list.title: Can this product be used on Body?
list.content: This products works well for both Face & Body.
